burmese_review.task: Independently review the natural Myanmar meaning and sense/register alignment; document reviewer and evidence.

example_review.task: Independently check original example grammar, collocation, register and exact sense.

cefr_review.task: Observe sense-specific CEFR evidence; if tier unsupported, quarantine or re-tier before any release.

audio_review.task: After full editorial approval, generate both George/Emma and listen; test real physical iPhone Safari.
